newsitem.title: INDIA: Nine guerrillas killed in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Nine guerrillas killed in Kashmir.

text.p: Indian soldiers killed nine guerrillas who had crossed the border from Pakistan in a gunbattle in Kashmir, a defence spokesman said on Wednesday.

The militants were killed overnight in Michil sector near the India-Pakistan border and about 85 km (55 miles) north of Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir state. Fighting between the army and militants continued on Wednesday morning, the spokesman said.
Three separatist guerrillas and two paramilitary troopers were killed on Monday in a gunbattle in the thick forests of Michil sector.
Earlier this month Indian security forces shot dead 13 separatist guerrillas near the border.
India accuses Pakistan of arming and training militants fighting New Delhi's rule in the Himalayan region. Islamabad says it provides only moral and diplomatic support.
Police and hospital officials say more than 20,000 people have died since a separatist revolt broke out in mostly Hindu India's only Moslem majority state in 1990.
